name: gandiwa-studio
description: Compliance-aware local-first workspace for Adobe Stock contributors.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm -r --if-present build && uv build --project apps/api
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm verify
scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run --project apps/api pytest
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm -r --if-present lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api tests/scaffold
scripts.migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.migration:current: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini current
